goal.text: Work out why the tomato will not slice and get it cut.

turns.text: Which hand did I use to get that bowl down?

trigger.detail: bowl set down on the countertop and the upper doors being closed

expected_answer.text: Your left hand. You lifted it out of the right-hand upper cabinet with your left while your right hand was still holding that door open.

turns.text: Actually — did I get the fridge properly shut back there?

trigger.detail: gaze moved between the overhead units; the fridge is well out of view

expected_answer.text: Yes, you swung it shut with your right hand while the greens stayed in your left, then you veered right toward the counter.

turns.text: You've picked the bag up — checking if there's enough?

trigger.detail: pack lifted off the worktop, contents inspected, set back down

expected_answer.text: Looks like it. You lifted it, glanced inside, and put it straight back down on the same spot without taking anything out yet.

turns.text: Hold on — I opened and shut that drawer without taking anything. Do you know what I was reaching for?

trigger.detail: middle drawer pulled open a little and pushed shut again

expected_answer.text: You didn't take anything out of it. You slid it open a little, closed it again, and went straight back to the pack on the counter.

turns.text: Back to the greens — how much is left?

trigger.detail: about twenty seconds of continuous transfer with no new question

expected_answer.text: You've been emptying it steadily for about twenty seconds now. The bag is maybe half down, and you switched to scooping with your left hand a moment ago.

turns.text: It was the other one first. When did I swap?

trigger.detail: user follows up on the hand change

expected_answer.text: Right at first. You scooped with that one for about ten seconds, then swapped, and you've stayed swapped for the last ten or so.

turns.text: Sorry, quick one — so is the bowl going to take all of it, or should I grab a second?

trigger.detail: user asks for a judgement about capacity

expected_answer.text: It should. The bowl you took down is still well short of full even with most of the bag already tipped in.

turns.text: Twice over here now. What did I pull out first time?

trigger.detail: second approach to the fridge, door opened again

expected_answer.text: A bag of leafy greens, nothing else. You bent down for it, stood up and shut the door behind you with the same hand.

turns.text: Second trip. What have I got hold of in there?

trigger.detail: focus left the worktop side of the kitchen for the inside of the fridge

expected_answer.text: A sealed pack of vegetables, not loose leaves this time. You have it in your left hand and the door is still held open with the right.

turns.text: Mm-hm... mm— and actually, hang on: am I still hanging onto the first lot as well?

trigger.detail: backchannel turns into a question about the earlier item

expected_answer.text: No, you left it behind. You put it down on the counter with both hands just before you turned round and walked over here.

turns.text: I've got both now. Which hand ended up shutting it?

trigger.detail: fridge closed again, both items carried away

expected_answer.text: Your left, which is a switch; the first time round you closed it with your right. Everything you had collected was bundled into the other hand.

turns.text: Mm-hm... mm— and this one again? I keep opening it.

trigger.detail: drawer pulled open and the slide-out board touched

expected_answer.text: Twice now, and a third pull just started. Each time your hand lands on the board that slides out underneath rather than anything inside.

turns.text: No, I mean — not the drawer itself; the flat thing I keep touching. What is it?

trigger.detail: user repairs their own previous question

expected_answer.text: It is a pull-out cutting board set into the unit under the worktop. You slide it forward, touch it, and push the drawer shut again each time.

turns.text: Something's on it at last. What came out the bag?

trigger.detail: tomato placed down on the slide-out board

expected_answer.text: A tomato. You pulled a wrapped bag of food out first, had a look, put it back, and then lifted the tomato out instead.

turns.text: That one went back. What am I rummaging through here?

trigger.detail: a kitchen drawer opened and its contents handled

expected_answer.text: A drawer of utensils. You have hold of it with your right and you are sorting through the contents with your left, picking things up and dropping them back.

turns.text: Um, hang on — I had one of them in my hand already. Did I put it back?

trigger.detail: user is unsure about what they just did

expected_answer.text: You did. You lifted one out, held it for a moment, then set it straight back down among the others and carried on looking.

turns.text: How long looking for the right blade?

trigger.detail: a long searching stretch with no question in it

expected_answer.text: Roughly twenty seconds so far. You went through one drawer, opened and shut two more down here, and you still have nothing in your hand.

turns.text: Oh — by the way, was there a plant back there?

trigger.detail: gaze left the fridge end of the room for the unit by the hob

expected_answer.text: Yes, a potted one came into view twice while you were at the drawer, off to the side, and it has been out of shot since.

turns.text: And here? I've had about three of these in and out of the block.

trigger.detail: another blade returned and a different one drawn

expected_answer.text: At least three, yes. Each one comes out, gets looked at, and goes straight back before you reach for the next along the row.

turns.text: Is it me, or have I picked a dud?

trigger.detail: tomato lifted and set down again part way through a cut

expected_answer.text: The blade is barely marking it. You have tried four or five passes, lifted it, repositioned it, and the skin is still unbroken.

turns.text: Hang on — which of them did I pull out first? I want the one I skipped.

trigger.detail: user wants to go back to an earlier candidate

expected_answer.text: You put the first one straight back and took another; the one in your hand is not the first you drew. More are still sitting in the block.

turns.text: I've swapped and come back. Is this one better?

trigger.detail: returned to the board with a different blade and started cutting

expected_answer.text: Yes. It is biting on the first pass this time, and you are already through the skin rather than sliding over it.

turns.text: Good, that's the one then. So the problem was just which I grabbed?

trigger.detail: first clean slice completed

expected_answer.text: It looks that way. Same tomato, same board, same hand; only the blade changed, and it is cutting cleanly now.
